dashboard.heroDesc: Learn and master standard quality control protocols established by IAEA and NEMA NU 2. Explore detector calibrations, phantom configurations, and modern deep-learning image enhancement pipelines safely without clinical radiation hazards.

uniformityLab.title: Daily Uniformity & Crystal Response Workbench (IAEA / AAPM TG-108)
uniformityLab.desc: Evaluates detector response homogeneity across the transverse FOV using a uniform Ge-68 cylinder. Move the green circular ROI or toggle the defect simulation to see how dead detector blocks impact Integral Uniformity (IU) and Differential Uniformity (DU).
uniformityLab.defectHint: Simulates a failed photomultiplier tube (PMT) or detached light guide.
uniformityLab.iuFormulaDesc: Overall variation across entire sampled ROI
uniformityLab.duFormulaDesc: Short-range rate of change between adjacent crystals
uniformityLab.dailyIuTolerance: IU must be <= 5.0% across all evaluated slices.
uniformityLab.dailyIuRemedy: Perform full detector normalization calibration scan. If failing persistently, check crystal gain maps and PMT voltages.
uniformityLab.dailyDuTolerance: DU must be <= 3.5% across adjacent detector crystals.
uniformityLab.dailyDuRemedy: Inspect sinogram for isolated crystal streak artifacts or loose electronic cabling.

resolutionLab.title: NEMA NU 2 Spatial Resolution Workbench
resolutionLab.desc: Measures the scanner's point spread function (PSF). Click on the 2D reconstructed image or adjust the sliders to change radial distance, reconstruction smoothing, and statistical noise. The line profile updates dynamically to derive FWHM and FWTM.
resolutionLab.doiEffect: Depth of Interaction (DOI) parallax blurring occurs at peripheral radial offsets.
resolutionLab.fwhmTolerance: FWHM must be <= 4.5 mm at 1 cm radius from FOV center.
resolutionLab.fwhmRemedy: Check reconstruction filter cutoff frequency, crystal identification mapping matrices, and table centering laser alignment.

ai.title: Deep Learning Denoising & PVC Workbench
ai.subtitle: Explore artificial intelligence lesion recovery and ultra-low-dose PET enhancement pipelines
ai.doseAiDesc: Compare 25% dose scan vs. deep learning restored reconstruction
ai.archTitle: U-Net Architecture for Medical Image Restorations
ai.archSubtitle: Symmetric Contracting & Expanding Convolutional Pipeline with Long Skip-Connections
ai.skipConnDesc: Standard autoencoders lose high-frequency spatial localization during pooling. U-Net's skip connections copy precise anatomical edge features directly from contracting layers to synthesis layers, preserving sharp lesion borders.
ai.perceptualDesc: Training solely with Mean Squared Error (MSE) produces overly smooth, plasticky images that mask micro-calcifications. Adding VGG/Perceptual loss preserves realistic Poisson-like texture distribution expected by reading radiologists.

aiMetrics.psnrStandard: Standard: > 30 dB indicates high fidelity noise suppression without artifact creation.
aiMetrics.ssimDesc: Measures preservation of anatomical boundaries, organ shapes, and lesion borders.
aiMetrics.diceDesc: Overlap coefficient of metabolic tumor volume (>0.85 indicates excellent lesion detectability).
aiMetrics.clinicalGuidanceTitle: Clinical Quantitative Validation (Abdelrahman et al. / IAEA)
aiMetrics.clinicalGuidanceDesc: In low-dose oncology imaging, simple Gaussian post-smoothing improves SNR but suppresses critical small metastatic foci. The deep learning U-Net architecture trained with perceptual loss preserves fine structural edges while reducing radiation dose by up to 75%.

pvc.bannerTitle: Partial Volume Effect (PVE) & Contrast Recovery in Oncology
pvc.bannerDesc: Due to finite detector resolution (~4.5 mm FWHM), radioactive activity spills out of small tumors into surrounding cooler tissue. This causes serious underestimation of tumor SUVmax in lesions smaller than 2-3 times the FWHM. Partial Volume Correction (PVC) restores true quantification.
pvc.crcCurveTitle: NEMA IEC Contrast Recovery Coefficient (CRC) Curve
pvc.crcDesc: The curve illustrates how contrast recovery drops below 60% for lesions under 15 mm in conventional reconstructions, while deep-learning PVC restores quantification fidelity to within ±5% of ground truth.
